raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Norris Bradbury as the director of the project that developed the first atomic bomb, conflating Bradbury’s later leadership and role in the Trinity assembly with J. Robert Oppenheimer’s wartime directorship of the Los Alamos Laboratory (Project Y). This reflects a misinterpretation of historical roles/timelines and premature conclusion without proper verification.
